mission: Exterior. The wrongness spikes without warning. Ben staggers; Torin tilts his head toward the spike with attentive listening. It stabilises at a higher baseline. Desh's scan: Veraine spent extended time at Maetha's — studying, not repurposing. A pilgrimage. The next Corridor stop is a settlement world.
why_now: Timeline compression before the midpoint. The wrongness has to move from 'background' to 'actively attacked' in a way that lands physically, and the chapter needs to deliver the settlement-world cue so Ch13's population stakes land without exposition.
conflict: Veraine is no longer only ahead — she is accelerating. Torin is no longer only philosophically comfortable — he is orientating to her signal. The next stop on the Corridor is a populated world, and that will either be the group's first civilian encounter or a scene they will not recover from.
turning_point: Desh's read of Veraine's time at Maetha's: she sat where the Knights trained. Not logistics, pilgrimage. Her lineage acquires an ancestor, and her project gains a shape the group can begin to map.
opening_hook: The wrongness spikes without warning. Ben staggers. Torin doesn't — he turns toward it.
closing_hook: The spike stabilizes at a new, higher baseline. The seal is weakening faster. And the next node on the Corridor — the one Desh flagged with the most recent energy signatures — is a settlement world. Civilians lived there. Possibly still do.
emotional_trajectory: Physical shock -> urgent assessment -> grim realization of acceleration

stakes.personal: Ben feeling the seal's failure in real time — visceral, not abstract
stakes.interpersonal: Torin's reaction to the spike against everyone else's — the gap widening
stakes.external: The seal is failing faster. Days have become critical.

setting: Maetha's Training Facility exterior, then departure aboard the Steady Returns
sensory_details: The wrongness spiking as a sudden pressure drop in the body — knees registering it before the ears do; the flexible Weave at Maetha's location snapping briefly into chaos before settling; Torin's tilted-head listening, attentive to something no one else wants to hear; Desh's chrono running one second fast against Ben's

Sera braces against the wall with both palms as the Force destabilizes around them
Torin tilts his head toward the spike with an attentive listening posture while everyone else recoils
Desh punches the nav display to life and plots their course to the next node — a settlement world
notes: H12 planted — the wrongness lurches, the seal is being deliberately attacked. Rotate Force-wrongness metaphor: not handrail, not flat-note, not bass-below-hearing. Here the register is pressure-drop in the body, a physical wobble the knees catch before the ears do. One consistent image, carried through the scene. Diagnostic-voice trap — Ben should not, in this scene, narrate 'the seal is being actively attacked' as an interior realisation sentence. His body registers the spike; Desh's scan reads the pattern; the group's collective shift does the work. Settlement-world cue at the close prepares Ch13 (Kolven) — the horror of the midpoint is that it was populated, and Ch12 gives that breath of knowing before the chapter ends.

turning_point_detail.trigger: Desh's read of Veraine's extended time at Maetha's — she sat where the Knights trained, not logistics or repurposing. A pilgrimage.
turning_point_detail.shift: Veraine's project acquires historical lineage and deliberate shape. She is not improvising or fleeing; she is executing a mapped strategy. The group can begin to anticipate her next moves because her pattern is becoming legible.
turning_point_detail.cost: Ben feels the seal's failure in real time — visceral, not abstract. The wrongness spike lands in his body before his mind can contextualize it. Simultaneously, Torin's reaction to the spike diverges sharply from everyone else's, widening the gap between him and the group. Ben now carries both the physical weight of acceleration and the interpersonal strain of Torin's dangerous attunement.

emotional_arc.start: Physical shock — the wrongness spike catches Ben's body before his mind can process it.
emotional_arc.shift: Urgent assessment — Ben's focus tightens on the pattern emerging from Desh's scan and Torin's reaction. The pressure becomes directional.
emotional_arc.end: Grim realization of acceleration — the timeline has compressed from days to hours. The next encounter will not be abstract. It will be populated.

key_beats.beat_description: Ben staggers as the wrongness spikes without warning — his hand catches the doorframe to stay upright. The pressure drops in his body; his knees register it before his ears do.
key_beats.state_change: The wrongness moves from background hum to acute physical event. The seal's failure is no longer theoretical.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben's body reacts before thought — a stagger, a catch, a moment where balance is not guaranteed. His instinct is to stabilize himself, not to narrate what is happening. The sensation is pressure-drop, a wobble in the knees, a sudden need for the doorframe to be solid.

key_beats.beat_description: Sera braces against the wall with both palms as the Force destabilizes around them. The flexible Weave at Maetha's location snaps briefly into chaos before settling.
key_beats.state_change: The spike escalates and confirms: this is not a localized fluctuation. The wrongness is spreading. The group's physical responses synchronize — everyone recoils.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben's focus tightens. The pressure is not random; it has a direction. His urgent assessment begins to map the pattern — where it came from, what it means, whether it will spike again.

key_beats.beat_description: Torin tilts his head toward the spike with an attentive listening posture while everyone else recoils. He does not brace. He does not stagger. He orients.
key_beats.state_change: The group's reaction fragments. Torin's attunement to the wrongness diverges sharply from the others'. He is not resisting the spike; he is listening to it. The gap between him and the group widens visibly.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben registers Torin's posture — the tilt of the head, the absence of recoil. The recognition lands as a cold spike of its own: Torin is not fighting the wrongness. He is attuned to it in a way that suggests alignment, not resistance. The cost of that realization settles into Ben's chest.

key_beats.beat_description: Desh punches the nav display to life and plots their course to the next node on the Corridor. The chrono on the display runs one second fast against Ben's own. The settlement world flags in red.
key_beats.state_change: The pattern becomes legible. Veraine's time at Maetha's was not logistics — it was pilgrimage. She sat where the Knights trained. Her lineage acquires an ancestor. Her project gains a shape the group can begin to map. And the next stop is not empty.
key_beats.pov_reaction: Ben's grim realization settles into place. The timeline has compressed. Days have become critical. The next encounter will not be abstract. It will be populated. The wrongness is accelerating toward civilians, and the group is still days behind Veraine's signal.
